ctx.x: And then there was Bass Edwards. He was another good tuba player.

Yeah. But I never worked with Bass Edwards nowhere. Nowhere at all. Everybody always told me how good he was, but I didn't see him getting any work. I guess he worked. But you know, he was a little ahead of my time.
